name: API-001 - Admin Authentication & Token Generation Endpoint
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/admin/auth/login endpoint handling credentials verification, MFA check, and issuing signed JWT access/refresh tokens with admin claims. Expectation: Returns HTTP 200 with tokens on success; rate-limits failed login attempts.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts email and password payload with input validation
- Verifies password hash using argon2/bcrypt
- Issues short-lived Access Token (15 min) and HTTP-only Refresh Token cookie (7 days)
- Returns Admin Profile object including permissions array
- Returns 401 Unauthorized for invalid credentials and logs failed attempt

name: API-002 - Token Refresh & Session Verification Endpoint
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/admin/auth/refresh endpoint to handle token rotation and session validation. Expectation: Rotates refresh token cleanly and revokes old tokens.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Validates HTTP-only refresh token cookie
- Checks database session state to verify token is not revoked or blacklisted
- Issues new Access Token and rotated Refresh Token
- Returns 401 if refresh token is expired or revoked

name: API-003 - Admin Logout & Token Revocation Endpoint
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/admin/auth/logout endpoint to invalidate active session tokens. Expectation: Blacklists active access token and clears cookies.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Blacklists current Access Token JTI in Redis/Database cache
- Clears HTTP-only Refresh Token cookie
- Emits AUDIT_LOG_ADMIN_LOGOUT event
- Returns HTTP 200 OK success message

name: API-004 - Paginated Users List & Search API Endpoint
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/admin/users endpoint supporting full-text search, pagination, and multi-field filtering. Expectation: Sub-100ms response time with indexed DB queries.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts query parameters: page, limit, search, role, status, sortBy, sortOrder
- Performs case-insensitive search across Name, Email, and User ID
- Returns paginated JSON response with data array and meta pagination object
- Enforces RBAC permission users:read

name: API-005 - User Profile & Activity History Detail API
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/admin/users/{id} endpoint returning full user profile, meeting history, and active subscriptions. Expectation: Consolidated payload for admin drawer view.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Returns user profile metadata, verification status, and registration IP
- Includes array of recent 10 meetings hosted/joined
- Includes active subscription details and payment status
- Returns 404 Not Found if user ID does not exist

name: API-006 - User Account Suspension API Endpoint
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/suspend endpoint to update user status and revoke current active meeting tokens. Expectation: Mandates reason string in request body and triggers audit log.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Requires JSON body: { "reason": "string (min 10 chars)" }
- Updates user status in DB to SUSPENDED
- Invalidate user's active meeting join tokens in Redis
- Emits AUDIT_USER_SUSPENDED log with reason and admin ID
- Returns HTTP 200 with updated user state

name: API-007 - User Ban & Immediate Session Purge API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/ban endpoint for severe account termination. Expectation: Instantly kicks user from any active WebRTC meeting rooms and revokes all refresh tokens.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Requires JSON body: { "reason": "string", "confirmationCode": "CONFIRM BAN" }
- Updates user status in DB to BANNED
- Dispatches WebSockets/Redis pub-sub signal to WebRTC SFU to drop participant connections
- Revokes all refresh tokens for the user in Redis
- Emits high-priority AUDIT_USER_BANNED event

name: API-008 - Organization Management & Seat Allocation API
Description:
Implement GET and PATCH /api/v1/admin/organizations endpoints to list enterprise accounts and update seat allocations. Expectation: Updates seat caps and syncs with Odoo.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GET endpoint returns list of Organizations, Admin Contact, Seat Limit, and Plan
- PATCH endpoint updates seat allocation limit or plan tier
- Emits AUDIT_ORG_UPDATED event
- Triggers background sync event to Zammy's Odoo 19 instance

name: API-009 - Payment Transactions & Webhook Log API
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/admin/financials/transactions endpoint returning payment attempts and raw gateway payloads. Expectation: Filterable by payment type, status, and gateway.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Paginated results of transactions (Ref, Amount, Currency, Status, Gateway)
- Query params: status, paymentType, gateway, startDate, endDate
- Endpoint includes raw_webhook_payload JSON field for detailed diagnostic view
- Enforces RBAC permission financials:read

name: API-010 - Manual Comp Access Grant API Endpoint
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/admin/financials/entitlements/grant endpoint to issue manual access to paid events or replays. Expectation: Creates entitlement record and emits strict audit event.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Payload: { "userId": "string", "targetType": "EVENT"|"REPLAY", "targetId": "string", "expiryDate": "ISOString", "reason": "string" }
- Inserts access entitlement record into DB
- Emits AUDIT_MANUAL_ENTITLEMENT_GRANTED with admin ID and reason
- Syncs entitlement update to Zammy's Odoo 19 subscription records

name: API-011 - Entitlement Revocation API Endpoint
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/admin/financials/entitlements/revoke endpoint to remove access. Expectation: Immediately invalidates entitlement and updates DB.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Payload: { "entitlementId": "string", "reason": "string" }
- Marks entitlement as REVOKED in database
- Clears cache key in Redis so media server blocks access
- Emits AUDIT_ENTITLEMENT_REVOKED event

name: API-012 - Active Live Meetings Overview API Endpoint
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/admin/diagnostics/meetings/active endpoint pulling real-time meeting room counts and participant loads from Redis/SFU. Expectation: Response under 50ms.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Queries Redis/SFU state for live meeting count, total connected participants, and aggregate bandwidth
- Returns list of active room summary objects (Room ID, Host Name, Duration, Participant Count, Server Node)
- Includes cache control headers for short TTL (5 seconds)

name: API-013 - Meeting WebRTC Stream Quality Metrics API
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/admin/diagnostics/meetings/{id}/webrtc-stats endpoint returning stream metrics. Expectation: Returns time-series stats of bitrate, packet loss, and jitter.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Fetches real-time or recent WebRTC stats for room ID from Redis timeseries / SFU telemetry
- Returns structured JSON containing average packet loss %, jitter (ms), audio bitrate, video bitrate
- Flags threshold warnings in response if packet loss > 3%

name: API-014 - Meeting Live Participant Inspector API
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/admin/diagnostics/meetings/{id}/participants endpoint listing connected clients and media states. Expectation: Lists all connected sockets in room.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Returns list of connected participants (Name, Client Type [Web/iOS/Android], Join Time, Audio Muted, Video Enabled)
- Displays client network health score (1-5)
- Returns 404 if meeting room ID is not active

name: API-015 - Remote Participant Reconnect Signal API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/admin/diagnostics/meetings/{id}/reconnect-participant endpoint to issue remote socket reconnect command. Expectation: Publishes socket event to force client media renegotiation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Payload: { "participantId": "string" }
- Publishes Redis pub-sub message to target SFU node to send RECONNECT_SIGNAL to client socket
- Returns success response confirmation
- Emits audit log entry for diagnostic action

name: API-016 - Diagnostic Snapshot Exporter API Endpoint
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/admin/diagnostics/meetings/{id}/export-snapshot endpoint packaging meeting state into JSON download. Expectation: Sanitizes private data while exporting technical logs.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Assembles room config, SFU telemetry, WebRTC metrics, and recent error logs
- Sanitizes PII (hashes IP addresses, obfuscates personal emails)
- Returns downloadable .json content stream with header Content-Disposition: attachment

name: API-017 - AI Services Processing Queue Monitor API
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/admin/ai/jobs endpoint returning background AI job statuses (Transcripts, Summaries). Expectation: Displays queue health and failure rates.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Queries BullMQ/Celery/Redis background queue for job statuses
- Returns list of jobs (Job ID, Meeting ID, Status [PENDING/PROCESSING/COMPLETED/FAILED], Error Message)
- Filterable by status query parameter

name: API-018 - AI Failed Job Retry Trigger API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/admin/ai/jobs/{id}/retry endpoint to re-enqueue a failed transcript or summary job. Expectation: Re-submits job payload to queue.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Re-enqueues specified failed AI job ID into worker queue
- Resets job error attempt counter
- Emits AUDIT_AI_JOB_RETRIED event
- Returns HTTP 200 with new job status

name: API-019 - AI Summary Content Moderation & Publish API
Description:
Implement PATCH /api/v1/admin/ai/summaries/{id} endpoint allowing admins to edit and approve AI summary text before publishing to replays. Expectation: Updates DB and flags summary as approved.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts updated summary text, takeaways array, and isPublished boolean
- Updates summary record in DB
- Emits event to trigger public replay notification if published
- Logs admin content edit action

name: API-020 - Platform Recordings Metadata API Endpoint
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/admin/content/recordings endpoint returning paginated list of platform media assets. Expectation: Returns file size, duration, host ID, storage tier, and expiry date.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Paginated results of recordings metadata stored in DB / S3 / Object Storage
- Query params: search (meeting title/host), storageTier (HOT/COLD), isPrivate
- Includes calculated system total storage consumed metric

name: API-021 - Break-Glass Emergency Recording Stream Generator API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/admin/content/recordings/{id}/break-glass endpoint for temporary admin replay viewing. Expectation: Generates short-lived signed URL and dispatches alert.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Payload requires: { "ticketId": "string", "justification": "string", "adminPassword": "string" }
- Verifies admin password hash
- Generates 15-minute expiring S3/CDN signed URL
- Dispatches high-priority alert email/Slack message to Security Lead and logs AUDIT_BREAK_GLASS_RECORDING_ACCESS

name: API-022 - GDPR Hard Delete Recording & Media Purge API
Description:
Implement DELETE /api/v1/admin/content/recordings/{id} endpoint to permanently purge recording files. Expectation: Deletes S3 object and DB metadata.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Requires confirmation payload: { "confirmation": "DELETE RECORDING" }
- Deletes object file from Cloud Storage bucket
- Deletes DB recording record, transcript, and AI summary
- Emits AUDIT_RECORDING_PURGED event

name: API-023 - Primary Headline KPIs Analytics API Endpoint
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/admin/analytics/kpis/headline endpoint returning Free Users vs Paid Users counts and period growth. Expectation: Powers the top North Star KPI cards.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Returns Total Free Users count + MTD growth %
- Returns Total Paid Users count + MTD growth %
- Cached in Redis with 1-hour TTL for optimal performance
- Supports query param period (day, week, month, year)

name: API-024 - Platform Usage Trends Analytics Aggregator API
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/admin/analytics/trends endpoint returning time-series data for meetings, replays, and revenue. Expectation: Structured data formatted for charting libraries.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Aggregates daily/weekly counts for Meetings Hosted, Join Rates, Replay Views, and Revenue
- Query params: startDate, endDate, granularity (daily/weekly)
- Handles empty date ranges with zero-filled arrays

name: API-025 - Country Growth & Distribution Analytics API
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/admin/analytics/countries endpoint returning user and revenue metrics broken down by country code. Expectation: Powers international growth widget.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Returns list of objects: Country Code, Country Name, Free Users, Paid Users, Free-to-Paid Conversion Rate %
- Sortable by Free Users or Paid Users
- Includes support ticket count per country

name: API-026 - Odoo 19 User Registration Event Dispatcher Worker
Description:
Develop background queue worker emitting USER_REGISTERED payload to Zammy's Odoo 19 XML-RPC/REST endpoint. Expectation: Pushes User ID, Name, Email, Country, Referral Code, and Lead Source.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Listens to USER_REGISTERED event on message queue
- Constructs JSON payload with User ID, Email, Country Code, Referral Code, Lead Source, and Registration IP
- Posts to Zammy's Odoo 19 konn3ct_subscriber_sync endpoint
- Retries up to 5 times with exponential backoff on failure

name: API-027 - Odoo 19 Platform Usage Metrics Dispatcher Worker
Description:
Develop background queue worker publishing Usage Signals (Meetings Hosted, Meetings Joined, Replay Views, AI Notes Used) to Zammy's Odoo 19 instance. Expectation: Powers Zammy's Customer Health Score engine in Odoo 19.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Aggregates user daily activity: Meetings Hosted, Meetings Joined, Watch Time, AI Summaries Used
- Dispatches payload to Zammy's Odoo 19 konn3ct_usage_intelligence endpoint
- Includes User ID, Activity Type, Count, and Timestamp
- Enables Zammy to compute Customer Health Score (0-100) in Odoo 19

name: API-028 - Odoo 19 Payment Success & Failure Signal Dispatcher
Description:
Develop worker publishing PAYMENT_SUCCESS and PAYMENT_FAILED payloads (including Abandoned Checkout flags) to Zammy's Odoo 19 instance. Expectation: Powers Odoo 19 Invoicing and Payment Recovery campaigns.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Listens to PAYMENT_SUCCESS and PAYMENT_FAILED queue events
- Includes Tx Ref, User ID, Amount, Currency, Plan/Event ID, Gateway, Error Code, and Abandoned Cart Flag
- Posts payload to Zammy's Odoo 19 payment recovery listener
- Idempotency key (Tx Ref) prevents duplicate invoice creation in Odoo 19

name: API-029 - Odoo 19 Helpdesk Diagnostic Data Sync Worker
Description:
Develop worker pushing Konn3ct support ticket events and Diagnostic Snapshot JSON URLs to Zammy's Odoo 19 Helpdesk module. Expectation: Connects platform diagnostics directly to Odoo 19 tickets.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Pushes Ticket ID, User Email, Issue Category, and Diagnostic Snapshot URL to Zammy's Odoo 19 Helpdesk API
- Maps payment tier to ticket priority (Paid User = High Priority in Odoo 19)
- Handles webhook updates from Zammy's Odoo 19 instance when ticket status changes

name: API-030 - Immutable Audit Log Reader & Event Dispatcher Service
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/admin/audit-logs and backend interceptor decorator @AuditLog for state changes. Expectation: Read-only audit log API and non-blocking event emission.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GET /api/v1/admin/audit-logs returns read-only array of audit logs (Timestamp, Admin ID, Action, Target ID, Payload JSON, IP)
- Interceptor @AuditLog automatically extracts Admin Session ID, IP, User Agent, and Target ID
- Enforces strict SuperAdmin role check (returns 403 for non-SuperAdmins)
- Asynchronously writes audit records without blocking response

name: API-031 - Meeting Scheduling & Session Creation API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/meetings/schedule endpoint handling session creation, recurring rule setup, and invite link generation. Expectation: Inserts room record into DB and returns room payload.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts title, description, start time, duration, timezone, and security settings (waiting room, passcode)
- Generates unique Room ID and clean Join URL (/join/{roomId})
- Validates host authentication token and user entitlements
- Returns HTTP 201 Created with full meeting object

name: API-032 - Host Meetings & Replays List API
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/host/meetings endpoint returning paginated list of upcoming, past, and recorded sessions for the authenticated host. Expectation: Fast response for Feranmi's Host Workspace.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts query params: status (UPCOMING, PAST, REPLAY), page, limit
- Returns array of meeting objects with participant counts and replay availability status
- Filtered strictly by authenticated Host User ID
- Returns HTTP 200 with pagination metadata

name: API-033 - Paid Event Configuration API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/events/paid/config endpoint configuring paid webinar ticket price, currency, max capacity, and PayGate Shield link. Expectation: Connects event setup to Odoo and payment gateway.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts room ID, ticket price, currency (USD, NGN, KES), max capacity, and replay access policy
- Updates event record in DB and dispatches sync event to Zammy's Odoo 19 instance
- Generates payment gateway pricing references
- Returns HTTP 200 OK with confirmed event config

name: API-034 - Replay Publishing & Visibility Management API
Description:
Implement PATCH /api/v1/replays/{id}/visibility endpoint allowing hosts to set replay access mode (Private, Free Public, Paid Access). Expectation: Updates access entitlements in Redis.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts visibility state (PRIVATE, FREE_PUBLIC, PAID_ACCESS) and optional replay ticket price
- Updates replay metadata record in DB
- Refreshes Redis cache key for replay access enforcement
- Emits REPLAY_VISIBILITY_UPDATED event

name: API-035 - Pre-Meeting Token & Entitlement Validation API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/meetings/validate-join endpoint checking passcodes, waiting room status, user entitlements, and banned user status before room join. Expectation: Secure gatekeeper API.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts room ID, passcode, user token or guest name
- Checks if room is active, verifies passcode, checks if user is banned
- If waiting room enabled, returns status WAITING_ROOM_REQUIRED
- Returns temporary JOIN_TICKET token required for WebRTC handshake

name: API-036 - Waiting Room Admission Queue Signal API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/meetings/{id}/waiting-room/admit endpoint allowing host to admit participants from waiting room. Expectation: Publishes WebSocket signal to move client into room.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts participant ID and action (ADMIT or REJECT)
- Validates host permission for specified room ID
- Publishes Redis pub-sub message to signal client socket to proceed to room join
- Returns HTTP 200 OK success status

name: API-037 - WebRTC SFU Session Token & Signaling Handshake API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/meetings/{id}/signal-token endpoint issuing short-lived WebRTC signaling tokens. Expectation: Secure token for client-to-SFU media connection.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Validates JOIN_TICKET from validate-join step
- Issues signed WebRTC SFU connection token containing room ID, user ID, role (Host/Presenter/Attendee), and media permissions
- Includes target SFU node WebSocket URL based on geographic routing
- Token expires in 60 seconds to prevent unauthorized reuse

name: API-038 - Live Room In-Meeting Chat Message Dispatcher API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/meetings/{id}/chat endpoint handling in-meeting text messages and dispatches to Redis pub-sub. Expectation: Real-time chat distribution with persistence.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts room ID, message text, and chat target (PUBLIC or HOST_PRIVATE)
- Sanitizes input text against XSS injection
- Persists message to DB for meeting chat history logs
- Publishes socket event to room channels in Redis for instant client distribution

name: API-039 - In-Meeting Participant List & Hand-Raise Manager API
Description:
Implement GET and POST /api/v1/meetings/{id}/participants/hands endpoints managing hand-raising queue and live participant state. Expectation: Fast state updates.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GET endpoint returns active room participant list with muted/video/hand-raised states
- POST endpoint updates user hand-raised state (RAISE / LOWER)
- Publishes real-time state change to room participants via WebSockets
- Enables host to trigger Lower All Hands

name: API-040 - Host In-Meeting Moderation Actions API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/meetings/{id}/moderate endpoint for host actions: Mute All, Mute Participant, Kick Participant. Expectation: Instant host command execution.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts action type (MUTE_ALL, MUTE_PARTICIPANT, KICK_PARTICIPANT, LOCK_ROOM)
- Validates host/co-host permission
- Dispatches command via Redis pub-sub to SFU node to mute or drop participant WebRTC track
- Emits audit log entry for moderation action

name: API-041 - Webinar Q&A Submission & Upvoting API
Description:
Implement POST and PATCH /api/v1/webinars/{id}/qa endpoints allowing attendees to submit questions and upvote existing ones. Expectation: Threaded Q&A backend.

Acceptance Criteria:
- POST creates new Q&A question item with optional isAnonymous flag
- PATCH handles upvoting (action: UPVOTE) and increments vote count atomically
- Host endpoint allows marking question as ANSWERED_LIVE or inputting text reply
- Real-time Q&A list update pushed to webinar clients

name: API-042 - Presenter Elevation Signal API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/webinars/{id}/promote-presenter endpoint to invite view-only attendee to become a live Presenter. Expectation: Triggers media renegotiation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts target attendee user ID
- Dispatches invitation socket event to target client (PROMOTION_INVITATION)
- Upon client acceptance payload, updates user room role to PRESENTER in Redis
- Re-issues WebRTC SFU publish token for camera/mic access

name: API-043 - Replay Video Stream Signed URL Generator API
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/replays/{id}/stream-url endpoint verifying entitlement before returning S3/CDN signed HLS stream URL. Expectation: Enforces PayGate Shield.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Verifies user authentication and checks entitlement in Redis DB
- If free public replay, generates signed 2-hour S3/Cloudflare CDN stream URL
- If paid replay, checks active payment entitlement in DB before issuing URL
- Returns HTTP 403 Forbidden with PAYMENT_REQUIRED payload if unentitled

name: API-044 - Replay AI Summary & Chapter Index API
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/replays/{id}/ai-summary endpoint returning structured AI summary, key points, and timestamp markers. Expectation: Powers Feranmi's summary index.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Returns summary overview, key takeaways list, and timestamp markers array (e.g. { timestampSeconds: 255, title: 'Architecture' })
- Verifies replay visibility entitlement
- Cached in Redis for sub-20ms response time
- Returns empty array gracefully if AI processing is pending

name: API-045 - Synchronized Interactive Transcript Search API
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/replays/{id}/transcript endpoint returning full transcript with speaker IDs and search filtering. Expectation: Powers interactive transcript sidebar.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts query param q for full-text search within meeting transcript
- Returns array of transcript objects: { id, speakerName, timestampSeconds, text }
- Highlights matching keyword occurrences
- Fast JSON response optimized for timeline sync

name: API-046 - PayGate Shield Checkout Intent API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/checkout/intent endpoint creating payment gateway checkout session for paid webinars or replays. Expectation: Returns gateway transaction reference.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts payload: { targetType: 'EVENT'|'REPLAY', targetId: 'string', gateway: 'PAYSTACK'|'STRIPE' }
- Calculates ticket price and creates pending transaction record in DB
- Invokes Paystack/Stripe API to generate checkout URL / reference
- Returns HTTP 200 with gateway checkout payload

name: API-047 - Payment Verification & Instant Entitlement Unlock API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/checkout/verify endpoint verifying payment status and granting instant room/replay access. Expectation: Instant access grant post-payment.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts transaction reference and verifies payment with gateway API
- Updates transaction status to SUCCESS in DB
- Inserts entitlement record into Redis cache instantly
- Dispatches background event to Zammy's Odoo 19 instance for invoice logging

name: API-048 - Low-Bandwidth Stream Adaptation Command API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/meetings/{id}/low-bandwidth endpoint allowing clients to signal poor network and mute incoming video tracks. Expectation: Optimizes client data usage.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts client signal AUDIO_ONLY_MODE
- Instructs SFU media node to stop forwarding video RTP packets to target socket
- Reduces client bandwidth consumption significantly
- Emits telemetry metric tracking network adaptation

name: API-049 - Client Network Telemetry Collector API
Description:
Implement POST /api/v1/telemetry/client-network endpoint ingesting packet loss and latency logs from client browsers/mobile apps. Expectation: Feeds monitoring dashboards.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts JSON telemetry batch: RTT latency, packet loss %, frame rate, browser info
- Ingests telemetry into Redis TimeSeries / Datadog sink
- Flags meeting room ID if > 15% of participants report poor quality
- Asynchronous response returning HTTP 202 Accepted

name: API-050 - Active Recording & AI Note-taker Status API
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/meetings/{id}/recording-status endpoint returning live status of recording recorder and AI bots. Expectation: Powers top-bar badges in live room.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Queries active meeting recorder daemon state in Redis
- Returns object: { isRecording: boolean, isAiSummaryActive: boolean, recordingDurationSeconds: number }
- Verified cache response under 10ms
- Returns isRecording: false if session is not being recorded

name: API-051 - TrustLock Room Security Policy Enforcement API
Description:
Implement POST and PATCH /api/v1/meetings/{id}/trustlock-policy endpoints configuring dynamic watermarking, room lock, and screen share restrictions (Volume 10). Expectation: Emits instant pub-sub security update to room sockets.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepts payload: { isWatermarkEnabled: boolean, isRoomLocked: boolean, isScreenShareRestricted: boolean }
- Validates host/co-host permission
- Updates active room security configuration in Redis
- Dispatches WebSocket event to all connected room clients to apply dynamic watermarking or security locks

name: API-052 - TrustLock Participant Identity Verification Status API
Description:
Implement GET /api/v1/meetings/{id}/trustlock-verification endpoint returning enterprise SSO identity verification status for connected room participants. Expectation: Powers verified checkmark badges.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Returns list of objects: { userId, isEnterpriseVerified: boolean, verificationIssuer: string }
- Verifies SAML/OAuth/SSO identity tokens against enterprise organization directory
- Used by Feranmi's frontend to render green verified identity badges
- Returns cached result from Redis
